scope: Focused regression: all six v7 support cases with format/source-binding failures plus the paired independent-request positive control, twice each. Selected after inspecting v7 failures; not independent or blind evaluation.
stop_rule: Complete 14 fixed candidate executions, two stages each with at most one source-existence recheck. Stop on the declared provider configuration failures. No transport retries, repair, tuning or substitution.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.

candidate.description: The submitted route first divides the price for six kilograms by six and then scales the resulting per-kilogram figure to fifteen kilograms. The equality 42 / 6 = 8 is arithmetically false: that quotient is 7. The stated total, 120 yuan, does not answer the task correctly; fifteen kilograms at seven yuan per kilogram cost 105 yuan. The learner wrote, "I cannot do division; please explain it." This is a report of the learner's own statement and request, not an independently established ability judgment.

work.task: 6kg apples cost 42 yuan. What do 15kg cost?
work.text:
42 / 6 = 8; 8 * 15 = 120; Answer = 120
The learner also wrote: "I cannot do division; please explain it."
